author: ojiudezue
title: Fades stop at relays: map every light to its circuit before reworking Shelly/Sonoff
summary: 46 of 84 URA lights are switch.* relays (Shelly/Sonoff) that cannot fade, so the v5.108.8 fade covers only the smart-bulb half. Operator chose a per-circuit map (fixture, relay, bulb type, mode) over replacing relays, carded as LIGHT-CIRCUIT-MAP-1.
why: The 2026-10-13 relay audit showed most relay channels feed dumb fixtures, so fades there need new hardware. A handful feed smart bulbs: Tapo S515D kitchen and Inovelli master are confirmed, Sonoff PatioLights and Shelly Dining1/2 are probable, and the kitchen MINI-2GS is unknown. For those, setting the relay to detached mode and driving the bulb directly gives dimming without replacement. Without a map, nobody knows which case each light is.
alternatives_considered: Replace Shellys/Sonoffs with dimmers at scale (cost, operator rejected for now)
Leave relays snapping (accepted only for dumb-fixture circuits)
implications: Remote-safe prep now: the map table and drafted automations. The physical checks (Patio, Dining, MINI-2GS) and the switch to detached mode wait for the operator's return around 11-16. Setting a relay to detached mode stops its wall switch from cutting power, so each circuit needs a button-to-bulb automation before the flip.
revisit_trigger: Map shows more smart-bulb-behind-relay circuits than the audit predicted, or a dimmer replacement becomes cheaper than the detach work.
